style: 3D animation, original character design, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
opening: the video opens mid-arc: ONE heavy brown bear in a mustard cardigan already dangles head-down from his left ankle on her rope from above, his gold key in his teeth, her red tag swinging on it
subject: exactly one bear and one fox, no other animals
second_characters: ONE ginger fox, the bank, emerald vest, silent
props: his gold key; her pair of red square tags, palm-sized, white grid, blank: one on his key, one in her vest; her rope loop; her straw; his clear honey jar, full; his pillow; his stump
environment: 0.00-0.80: open sunlit turquoise air, no wall, no floor. From 0.80: his den, round red door in daylight, moss floor, teal clay walls, moss bed by his stump
lighting: warm sunbeam on his muzzle always; rim: turquoise from the walls, gold daylight from his door

light_events.event: sunbeam flashes on his empty jar

motion_rule: he fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.sfx: 0.15 whoosh; 0.55 tag slaps lens; 1.0 flop in moss; 2.3 paw slap, key clink; 3.9 sticky slap, oof; 5.4 head thud; 6.6 rump thud; 7.8 LOUDEST slurp and sticky pop; 8.7 empty shake; 9.4 clink; 9.8 rope jerk

timeline.a: From the first frame, already head-down mid-arc: close-up, his face rushes into the lens, the red tag on his key slaps the glass
timeline.c: low from below, whips up at his face

timeline.a: her paw tugs the knot, her rope slips off; he lands head-first in the moss by his red door, his key flies from his teeth into his paw; mouth free, moving
close-up: he flops onto his belly, mouth moving, and shoves his key in his paw into the lens, the tag fills half the frame
timeline.c: low on the moss, jolting back from his paw

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, sits up, tucks his key into his pocket; she climbs his back onto his head
timeline.c: over her shoulder on his head, arcing

timeline.a: close-up: she slides down his chest and slaps her second tag onto his belly, it sticks; his belly bounces into the lens; mouth moving
timeline.c: head-on at his belly, snaps back

timeline.a: mouth moving, her paw shoves him back on his pillow
close-up: she yanks his pillow across the lens, his head knocks his stump
timeline.c: low by his stump, darts back

timeline.a: he jerks up into a wide-legged sit, rising from below, mouth moving, hugging his honey jar above her belly tag; her straw dips into his jar from above
timeline.c: head-on at eye level, lifts with him

timeline.a: peak, close-up: she yanks her straw up out of his jar, all his honey comes out on its tip as one golden lump into her mouth; his clear jar empty at lens
timeline.c: snaps in close at his jar, tilts up to her

timeline.a: he turns his empty jar upside down over his open mouth and shakes it, not a drop; her tail sweeps across the lens; his face dry
close-up: he pulls his key from his pocket and grips it in his teeth; her loop yanks his left ankle up, he whips head-down into the first arc, face rushing at the lens, both tags in frame
timeline.c: low from below, whips up at his face

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, drawn-out delivery, static camera, locked-off shots, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, two bears, humans, logos, letters or numbers on objects, lipstick, kiss mark, lip print, stamp, widescreen
